DE.why: Blind memory said 2015; SB 262 (ch. 374) approved 2016-08-10: DelDOT permit, background checks, insurance. Research correct.

KY.why: Blind memory said 2016; SB 153 (2015 RS, Acts ch. 19) signed 2015-03-19: TNC certificate, insurance, checks. Research correct.

ME.why: Blind memory said 2016; PL 2015 ch. 279 (LD 1379) has "insurance" title but adds SoS permit, driver checks: framework. Research correct.

MD.why: Blind memory said 2016; Ch. 204 of 2015 (SB 868) approved 2015-05-12: PSC registration, background checks, insurance. Research correct.

MT.why: Blind memory said 2017; Flathead Beacon 2015-05-13: law signed prior week creating PSC TNC licence class. One news source only.

OK.why: Blind memory said 2016; OCC: TNC Services Act 47 O.S. 1010-1030 effective 2015-07-01, so enacted 2015. Signing date not seen.

VT.why: Blind memory said 2017; H.10 (2018 Special Session) approved 2018-06-19 as Act 3; H.143 (2017) never became law. Research correct.

HI.why: Act 57 (HB1681 HD2 SD1, 2022; eff 2023-01-01): DOT permit, driver checks, preemption, permanent insurance. Act 236 (2016) was insurance-only.

CA.why: Both exclude. Candidates: 2013 CPUC decision (regulator), 2014 AB 2293 (insurance-only), 2019 statutory driver checks; permit regime is CPUC. Excluded.

notes.blind_phase: Blind list built from WA Joint Transportation Committee guide (Jan 2019: 49 states+DC with TNC laws, OR none, insurance-only HI/LA/MN/WA) plus own checks; WebSearch budget exhausted midway, so 34 states were blind from memory (unverified) and 14 sourced (AL AK GA IL LA ND SC WI MA CO NJ TX WA HI). Memory years were wrong for 7 states (see details); all 7 resolved in favour of the research year.
notes.counts: n_agree/n_year_diff/n_only_them/n_only_us are counted over the 48 states in my blind list (adopters); states null in both lists (CA, MN, OR) are not in these counts (CA flagged DISPUTED in details). n_year_diff = blind-vs-research differences before checking; all 7 resolved in favour of research.
notes.verification_levels: final.json: 41 verified, 6 single_source (AK CT MT NH OH OK), 1 fixed (HI), 1 disputed (CA), MN/OR null verified.
